item.title: The Latest: Trump says anything less than US control of Greenland is ‘unacceptable’ - WWAYTV3
item.description: President Donald Trump posted Wednesday on social media that anything less than U.S. control of Greenland is “unacceptable,” hours before Vice President JD Vance was to host Danish and Greenlandic officials for talks.
